annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it promotes restaurant gift card sales to raise money for a school among students, families, and friends. The PlayStation 3, free food, and limousine ride are presented as fundraising contest incentives rather than investments or payment-for-access offers. the available video evidence describes no entry fees, credential or private-data requests, deceptive claims, or harmful transaction outcomes.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central context is an ordinary school fundraising promotion in which selling restaurant gift cards is linked to contest-style rewards, including a PlayStation 3, free food for a year and a limousine ride.
